nom: Peace Out 2% Salicylic Acid Early Stage Acne Dot

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report the patches are gentle and non-irritating, with one noting reduced lingering red marks after breakouts.

concerns.spots: Reviewers describe applying the dot as soon as a pimple starts forming, with most reporting the bump shrinks or disappears by morning; a few say it did not remove or stop the spot at all.
concerns.blemishes: Many describe faster resolution of deep, under-the-skin and cystic blemishes with overnight use; one reviewer says it worked better on superficial pimples than on her deep cystic ones, and another says the whitehead did not lift as anticipated.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visibly reduced redness and swelling by the next morning; one reviewer still had some redness remaining the next day.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers say the patches did not dry out or irritate their skin, and one specifically notes no burning or barrier disruption; one reviewer reports an itchy red mark after use.

extraits.texte: Left an itchy red mark and the pimple is still there. Expensive for what you get.

gifted by peaceoutskincare. complimentary of peaceoutskincare. I don't think these work very well. I tried these several times and it didn't remove the early stage acne dots at all. I also don't like that it comes with only eight

I get hormonal acne from time to time.. those pesky, deep ones that just takes forever to form and finally go away. I was excited to try these and hopeful that it would hurry it along, since it is specifically for early stage acne. It has 430 dissolving micro needles to deliver salicylic acid, succinic acid and niacnimide deeper into skin. The concept is great and ultimately it does work with consistent use for about 3-4 days, which means you'll need a pack per pimple which can get rather costly. **gifted by peaceoutskincare

That'll do it! Love these acne patches!! Gentle enough for sensitive skin like mine, but still works hard to banish those pesky pimples that like to make a big entrance, or announce themselves before appearing. I definitely noticed a shorter life span of some pimples, & some didn't even appear all together after 1-2 of these! That's a major win. I'm prone to dark spots so these came in clutch to catch them before they go big enough or irritated enough! (gifted by peaceoutskincare in exchange for honest review)

Complimentary from Peace Out Skincare. I've been using PEACE OUT Early Stage Acne Dots for a few weeks now, usually put one on as soon as I feel a pimple starting to form, and most of the time it either shrinks overnight or never fully shows up. I like how fast it starts working. I have sensitive skin type and typically have after pimples a red marks but when I using this patches the marks doesn't stay for long or disappears. Very recommend trying.

Never used a patch product to help fight an oncoming pimple. I've been getting weird cystic acne so when an area on my face hurts, I know its time to be proactive. So far I've noticed results on more superficial pimples versus the deep cystic pimples ill get. Happy they help with something but if you're looking for help with really deep pimples, not sure if this is the one youre looking for. Complimentary from Peace Out Skincare.

I am so glad that I ran into these pimple patches because I am always in need of them. I have hormonal acne and sensitive skin so these patches literally saved my life to cover and shrink my pores overnight. gifted by peaceoutskincare I reccommend everyone to try it.
